question: Does the rebuild ship Burp's BApp Store? grep for 'bapp' finds nothing.
probes: List the original's BApp Store entries
Decide whether to reimplement or document as out of scope
resolution: RESOLVED (wave 23, 2026-11-15): the premise was wrong - build 52685 DOES ship the BApp Store (sub-tab at burp.Zg26.java:47, welcome card at burp.Zmx_.java:28; 'bapp' appears in ~10 jar classes). WebProbe now has the BApp Store surface in its Extensions tab: grounded sub-tab/copy strings and a static offline catalog of 8 well-known BApps. The live store is not fetched and Java BApp installation is unsupported (Rust-native extension host) - both stated honestly in the tab and in qa/SOURCE-PARITY-2026-11-15.md (BApp Store section).
